summary: Easier patient lookup, richer inquiry details, and several search and display fixes.

updates.title: Search by Previous SP Patient ID
updates.body: Patient search now matches previously used specialty pharmacy patient IDs, so patients stay findable after an ID change.

updates.title: Inbox Default Filter
updates.body: The Inbox now opens filtered to Unreviewed and Ready for Enrollment.

updates.title: CRx HCP ID in Directory
updates.body: The HCP Directory now includes a CRx HCP ID column, and search shows exact matches first.

updates.title: HCP Links in Patient Details
updates.body: Fixed HCP name links so they open the profile again.

updates.title: HCO Search by ID
updates.body: Fixed searching the HCO Profile by HCO ID so it returns results.

updates.title: Call and SMS Buttons
updates.body: Fixed Call and SMS buttons so they appear for all applicable roles.

updates.title: Patient Data Freshness
updates.body: Fixed patient summary data so it refreshes when an HCP affiliation or an HCO's primary address changes.

updates.title: Actionable Inquiry Filter
updates.body: The "Actionable Only" filter is now labeled "Actionable Inquiry" for clarity.

updates.title: Linked HCP After Enrollment
updates.body: Fixed an issue where an HCP linked during enrollment did not appear on the Patient Profile.

updates.title: Interaction Sorting
updates.body: Fixed Interaction lists so the most recent interactions appear at the top.

updates.title: Interaction Form Indicators
updates.body: Fixed the Interactions form marking Scheduled Date/Time as mandatory when Interaction Date/Time is the required field.
